title: 杭州商场：日销三四百万，奢侈品牌开业后能否跻身前三？
speaker: Adriel Chan

segments.en: And how much are you expecting Hangzhou to contribute to recurring income going forward? So far it's contributed about 37 million in rents. That's over two months of performance, which is not bad.
segments.zh: 您预计杭州未来对经常性收入的贡献有多大？目前租金贡献约3700万，这是两个多月的表现，还不错。

segments.en: I think in reality, it should ramp up quite a lot. Our sales are decent, but not fantastic. A couple of three or four million RMB day, which is sort of tracking, but I think that once the luxury brands open, we have a couple opening, and the rest of the mall opens, and then we should increase that substantially.
segments.zh: 实际上，租金应该会大幅提升。目前销售尚可，但不算突出，每天约三四百万人民币。一旦奢侈品牌陆续开业，整个商场全面运营，租金会大幅增长。

segments.en: And I think that this will be on par with our second or third best projects, which are maybe Shanghai or Wushie.
segments.zh: 我认为这将与我们的第二或第三大项目相当，比如上海或无锡的项目。
